recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work should reconcile only specific later NutritionIntake or NutritionProduct tracker issues, not FHIR-23074's already-applied add-to-build request.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO change request to add NutritionIntake resource files to the main build for connectathon testing, with a Jira comment also asking that NutritionProduct be added and updated; Jira records R5 as the applied version and approval by OO and FMG in 2020.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-23074. Git history shows NutritionIntake source and active fhir.ini registration added in bc846f6893c90972c1733248ee14a7193bdfd842 on 2019-08-05, and NutritionProduct source and active fhir.ini registration added in b6760dc1c906cb3cbc10bac370ee1375397b472b on 2020-01-25. FMG minutes from 2020-06-10 say these proposals had already been in draft in the build for several cycles.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively registers nutritionintake=NutritionIntake and nutritionproduct=NutritionProduct, assigns both to OO, assigns security categories, and gives both FMM 3. Current source contains StructureDefinition XML, examples, search parameter bundles, value sets, and module/navigation links for both resources. Later NutritionIntake and NutritionProduct tracker work confirms they are established active artifacts rather than missing draft files.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested add-to-build work is already present in current build-scoped source and no corrective source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Later Published R5 ballot issue about whether NutritionIntake exists; it confirms the resource entered the R5 publication stream but was not independently reconciled here.
Later Applied NutritionIntake constraint issue showing the resource continued to evolve after the add-to-build request; separate issue-specific review would be required.
